jobs.title: Customer Success Lead
jobs.description:
About Corridor

Software development is becoming autonomous. The fastest teams already work this way, and at Corridor, we are leading the way on secure development as the rest of the industry follows.

Security tools were designed for a world where a person wrote the code and a person reviewed it. That's changing quickly. Corridor is securing software factories. We are the security solution for software that builds itself at every level of autonomy. We are preventing vulnerabilities as agents write code, and guiding teams to help decide what's safe to ship.

We're a small, talented team, led by Jack Cable (Former CISA - Secure by Design) and Ashwin Ramaswami (Former CISA, Stanford, and Schmidt Futures).

Corridor is backed by Conviction, with a $25M Series A led by Felicis and our customers include ElevenLabs, Lovable, Mercor, and Langchain.


The Role

We’re looking for a Customer Success Lead to help make our customers successful and build the foundation of Corridor’s Customer Success function.

You’ll own relationships with a portfolio of customers while working closely with our business leaders to develop the playbooks, processes, and customer experience that will scale as we grow. This is a 0>1 and highly hands-on role for someone who enjoys working directly with customers while also helping build a function from the ground up.


What You’ll Do

 - Build trusted relationships with security, engineering, and technical leaders and become a strategic partner throughout the customer lifecycle.

 - Lead onboarding, adoption, ongoing engagement, renewals, and expansion, ensuring customers consistently see value from Corridor.

 - Monitor customer health, identify risks and opportunities early, and proactively drive successful outcomes.

 - Turn customer feedback, usage patterns, and challenges into actionable insights for Product, Sales, and the broader team.

 - Help turn successful customers into advocates, references, and expansion opportunities.

 - Partner with the Head of Customer Success to build and improve the customer journey, playbooks, processes, and operating rhythm.

 - Test what works, document it, and help make it repeatable as the function scales.


Who You Are

 - You’re a high-ownership customer operator who combines strong relationship skills with commercial and technical curiosity.

 - You have experience managing B2B customers and driving adoption, retention, and expansion, ideally in a technical product environment.

 - You’re comfortable working with security, engineering, infrastructure, or other technical teams and can quickly learn complex products.

 - You’re proactive and commercially minded, spotting risks and opportunities before they become problems.

 - You’re highly organized and comfortable operating without a fully established playbook.

 - You’re an excellent communicator who can build trust from individual contributors through executive stakeholders.

 - You enjoy moving quickly, taking ownership, and helping build something from the ground up.

Qualifications

 - 4–8+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions, or another customer-facing role

 - Experience managing B2B customers through onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion

 - Experience with technical products, ideally cybersecurity, developer tools, infrastructure, or AI

 - Strong track record of building customer relationships and driving measurable outcomes

 - Comfortable working in an early-stage environment and helping build processes from scratch
   

Equal Opportunity

Corridor is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We're looking for someone open to working in a hybrid environment; 3 days per week in our South Beach, San Francisco office (Mon, Wed, Fri).

jobs.title: Head of Business Partnerships
jobs.description:
ABOUT CORRIDOR

Software development is becoming autonomous. The fastest teams already work this way, and at Corridor, we are leading the way on secure development as the rest of the industry follows.

Security tools were designed for a world where a person wrote the code and a person reviewed it. That's changing quickly. Corridor is securing software factories. We are the security solution for software that builds itself at every level of autonomy. We are preventing vulnerabilities as agents write code, and guiding teams to help decide what's safe to ship.


We're a talented and growing team, led by Jack Cable https://www.linkedin.com/in/jackcable/ (Former CISA - Secure by Design) and Ashwin Ramaswami https://www.linkedin.com/in/ashwin-r/ (Former CISA, Stanford, and Schmidt Futures). Corridor is backed by Conviction, with a $25M Series A led by Felicis and our customers include ElevenLabs, Lovable, Mercor, and Langchain.




THE ROLE

We're hiring a Founding Head of Business Partnerships to build a partner ecosystem that accelerates Corridor's growth.

Your mission is to develop partnerships that create new routes to market, generate qualified pipeline, and drive revenue. You'll identify the right partners, build strong commercial relationships, and turn them into repeatable growth channels.

We're looking for someone with a proven track record of building successful partnerships in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or AI-native companies. Someone who knows how to create mutual value, bring partners into the sales process, and translate relationships into measurable business outcomes.

You'll work closely with Corridor's leadership and GTM teams to build the strategy and program from the ground up.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and own Corridor's business and channel partnership strategy, focused on customer acquisition and revenue growth.

 - Identify and develop partnerships across cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, developer tools, AI, and complementary B2B SaaS platforms.

 - Establish repeatable partnership models, including referrals, co-selling, resellers, and strategic alliances.

 - Build relationships with partner leadership and sales teams to develop joint go-to-market plans and generate pipeline.

 - Structure and negotiate commercial agreements that create value for both Corridor and its partners.

 - Work closely with Sales and Marketing to turn partner relationships into qualified opportunities, new customers, and revenue.

 - Define and track partnership performance, establishing the processes needed to scale a successful channel program.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Proven success building business, channel, or strategic partnerships at a B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or AI company.

 - Clear examples of partnerships that generated measurable pipeline, customer acquisition, or revenue.

 - Experience building a partner program or commercial channel from the ground up, ideally at an early-stage or high-growth company.

 - Strong understanding of channel sales, co-selling, referral programs, and partner-led go-to-market strategies.

 - Existing relationships across relevant technology ecosystems, with the ability to develop new ones.

 - Commercial judgment and strong negotiation skills, with the ability to identify and execute mutually beneficial opportunities.

 - An entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to own both strategy and execution in a fast-moving environment.

 - Genuine interest in AI-powered software development and the security challenges it creates.



EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Corridor is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We're looking for someone open to working in a hybrid environment 3 days per week in our South Beach, San Francisco office (Mon, Wed, Fri).
